insights_with_evidence.claim: 距离与接近性是服从行为的关键调节变量：学习者越近，服从率越低；远程条件下服从率高达93%，同房间需强迫时降至30%，电话命令仅21%。被试在服从同时会口头表达反对。

evidence.excerpt: Variations in the experimental design showed that obedience was highest when the learner was in a separate room, as opposed to being in close proximity to the subject (e.g., in the same room or near enough to touch). Subjects persisted in their obedience despite verbally expressing their disapproval of continuing with the shocks.
evidence.source_file: exa_Stanley Milgram _ Biography, Experiment, Books, & Facts _ Br.md

evidence.excerpt: 26 out of 40 men recruited for the study proved to be fully obedient to the experimenter, delivering shocks through 450 volts.
evidence.source_file: exa_Stanley Milgram _ Biography, Experiment, Books, & Facts _ Br.md

evidence.excerpt: 服从程度最高的时候（93% 的人施加了最高电压）是在学生在另一个房间，看不见或听不见的情况下。然而，当学生与老师在同一房间，而老师需要强迫学生把手放在电击板上时，服从率降至 30%。
evidence.source_file: exa_米爾格倫實驗- 維基百科，自由的百科全書.md

evidence.excerpt: 有一次，实验者离开房间，通过电话向被试者下达命令。在这种情况下，服从率仅为21%。
evidence.source_file: exa_米爾格倫實驗- 維基百科，自由的百科全書.md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 人们对自身道德行为的预测与现实严重脱节：专家预测仅1.2%会服从到底，实际65%服从；被试事前一致声称会反抗，事后的道德判断也指向反抗，但行为数据完全相反——价值判断与实际行为之间存在根本性断裂。

evidence.excerpt: Prior to carrying out the experiments, Milgram and Yale psychology students whom he polled about possible outcomes of such a study predicted that only a very small percentage (from 0 to 3 percent) of people would inflict the most-extreme-intensity shock. Hence, Milgram was surprised with the results of early pilot studies, in which most participants continued through to the extreme 450-volt limit.
evidence.source_file: exa_Stanley Milgram _ Biography, Experiment, Books, & Facts _ Br.md

evidence.excerpt: Hypothetical subjects respond in terms of ideals, values, and positive self-conceptions; these values are frequently overridden by the forces engendered in the concrete laboratory situation.
evidence.source_file: paper_Liberating effects of group pressure..md

evidence.excerpt: there is a clear consensus that the only behavior consistent with social values and individual conscience is to defy the experimenter at some point before the completion of the command series. Yet there is a marked discrepancy between this value judgment and the actual performance of subjects in the laboratory.
evidence.source_file: paper_Liberating effects of group pressure..md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 服从是社会生活的基本结构性要素：任何社会都需要权威系统，服从作为行为决定因素将个体行动与政治目的联系起来。服从倾向根深蒂固，能压倒伦理和道德训练，C.P. Snow指出以服从之名犯下的罪行远多于以反叛之名。破坏性服从是核心研究问题：当X命令Y伤害Z时，Y何时服从何时拒绝？

evidence.excerpt: 很大一部分人做他们被告知要做的事情，不管行为的内容如何，也没有良心的痛苦，只要他们认为命令来自合法的权力机构
evidence.source_file: exa_斯坦利米尔格拉姆传记：他对心理学的影响.md
evidence.location: 中段米尔格拉姆原话引用

evidence.excerpt: Obedience is as basic an element in the structure of social life as one can point to. Some system of authority is a requirement of all communal living, and it is only the man dwelling in isolation who is not forced to respond, through defiance or submission, to the commands of others.
evidence.source_file: exa_Obedience to Authority_ An Experimental View.md_chunk1.md

evidence.excerpt: In its most general terms, the problem of destructive obedience may be defined thus: If X tells Y to hurt Z, under what conditions will Y carry out the command of X, and under what conditions will he refuse?
evidence.source_file: paper_Issues in the study of obedience_ A reply to Baumrind..md_chunk1.md

evidence.excerpt: Obedience is as basic an element in the structure of social life as one can point to. Some system of authority is a requirement of all communal living, and it is only the man dwelling in isolation who is not forced to respond, through defiance or submission, to the commands of others. Obedience, as a determinant of behavior, is of particular relevance to our time. It has been reliably established that from 1933-45 millions of innocent persons were systematically slaughtered on command. Gas chambers were built, death camps were guarded, daily quotas of corpses were produced with the same efficiency as the manufacture of appliances. These inhumane policies may have originated in the mind of a single person, but they could only be carried out on a massive scale if a very large number of persons obeyed orders. Obedience is the psychological mechanism that links individual action to political purpose. It is the dispositional cement that binds men to systems of authority.
evidence.source_file: paper_Behavioral Study of obedience..md

evidence.excerpt: for many persons obedience may be a deeply ingrained behavior tendency, indeed, a prepotent impulse overriding training in ethics, sympathy, and moral conduct. C. P. Snow (1961) points to its importance when he writes: When you think of the long and gloomy history of man, you will find more hideous crimes have been committed in the name of obedience than have ever been committed in the name of rebellion.
evidence.source_file: paper_Behavioral Study of obedience..md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 米尔格拉姆的学术道路深受阿希从众实验启发，从研究助理做起后将类似范式发展为服从实验。他明确将自身研究与阿希对比，但强调超越言语层面的从众，转向行为层面。

evidence.excerpt: 在他的研究生学习期间，Milgram花了一年的时间担任Solomon Asch的研究助理，他对符合社会团体感兴趣。Asch着名的符合性实验涉及让参与者判断一条线的长度。米尔格拉姆受到了这项研究的启发，并继续进行一项类似的实验，这将使他成名。
evidence.source_file: exa_斯坦利米尔格拉姆传记：他对心理学的影响.md
evidence.location: 职业和着名的服从实验段落

evidence.excerpt: Whereas Asch and others have shown in what manner group pressure can cause a person to pronounce judgments that contradict his thinking, the present study examines whether group pressure causes a person to engage in acts at variance with his uninfluenced behavior.
evidence.source_file: paper_Group pressure and action against a person..md_chunk2.md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 米尔格拉姆系统比较本实验与Asch范式的5个关键差异：内在标准vs外在刺激、行为不可逆性、结果竞争性、压力指向行动本身而非判断、以及对不同社会关系的违反。行动顺从意味着彻底的屈服——没有保留内心真实判断的余地。

evidence.excerpt: While in the Asch study the focus of pressure is directed toward the subject's judgment, with distortion of public response but an intermediary stage of influence, here the focus of pressure is directed toward performance of action itself. Asch's yielding subject may secretly harbor the true judgment; but when the performance of an action becomes the object of social pressure, there is no comparable recourse to a covert form. The subject who performed the act demanded by the group has yielded exhaustively.
evidence.source_file: paper_Group pressure and action against a person..md

evidence.excerpt: A misspoken judgment can, in principle, be withdrawn, but here we are dealing with action that has an immediate and unalterable consequence. Its irreversibility stems not from constraints extrinsic to the action, but from the content of the action itself: once the Learner is shocked, he cannot be unshocked.
evidence.source_file: paper_Group pressure and action against a person..md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 丢失信件技术是一种不引人注目的社会态度测量方法：在城市散落不同收件人的信件，以返还率衡量社区社会取向。医学机构返还率72%，共产党和纳粹党仅25%。优势在于参与者几乎意识不到自己在参与调查。

evidence.excerpt: The technique consists of dispersing in city streets (and other locations) a large number of unmailed letters. The letters are enclosed in envelopes that have addresses and stamps on them but that have not yet been posted. When a person comes across one of these letters on the street, it appears to have been lost. Thus he has a choice of mailing, disregarding, or actively destroying the letter. By varying the name of the organization to which the letter is addressed and distributing such "lost letters" in sufficient quantity, it is possible to obtain a return rate specific to the organization.
evidence.source_file: paper_The Lost-Letter Technique_ A Tool of Social Research.md

evidence.excerpt: Seventy-two per cent of the Medical Research letters and 71 per cent of the Personal letters were received in our post office box, but the Communist and Nazi Party return rates were each 25 per cent.
evidence.source_file: paper_The Lost-Letter Technique_ A Tool of Social Research.md

evidence.excerpt: there are compensatory advantages: (1) the person who comes across the letter rarely if ever realizes he is a participant in a sociological survey, (2) an ordinary action is used as the basis of measurement, and (3) the responses can be gathered up conveniently in a post office box. With proper controls the technique can prove a useful and unobtrusive means of gathering information on selected social issues.
evidence.source_file: paper_The Lost-Letter Technique_ A Tool of Social Research.md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 米尔格拉姆强调术语的语义严谨性和实验有效性：'服从'等术语需从具体行为语境中获取含义；绝大多数被试接受了受害者反应的真实性，证据包括紧张反应、疼痛量表和事后访谈。

evidence.excerpt: In the final analysis, the linguistic symbol representing the subject's action must take its meaning from the concrete context in which that action occurs; and there is probably no word in everyday language that covers the experimental situation exactly, without omissions or irrelevant connotations. It is partly for convenience, therefore, that the terms obey and disobey are used to describe the subject's actions.
